proposed_dimension: d=max{k in 0..n: integral_X <T_psi^k> wedge omega^(n-k)>0}; d<n must follow from zero class volume. Independence of positivity/nonvanishing from omega follows pointwise comparison of Kahler forms; equality under bounded singularity type uses DDNL Proposition2.1. operator_candidate: mu_{u,omega}=<T_u^d> wedge omega^(n-d), an actual unnormalized nonpluripolar Radon measure on X (carrier dimension n; product bidegree d). This is not automatically a geometric d-dimensional carrier. Raw mass M_d(psi,[omega]) retained, positive even d=0.
energy_candidate: E_{psi,[omega]}(u)=1/(d+1) sum_{a=0}^d integral_X (u-psi)<T_u^a wedge T_psi^(d-a)> wedge omega^(n-d). Bounded difference integrated off polar locus, arbitrary extension there irrelevant. Prove representative independence of omega rather than assume it.
proposed_lemmas: For all bounded-type u_i and k>d, positivity plus DDNL mixed top-mass equality with n-k smooth omega factors should give <T_u1 ... T_uk>=0 as positive currents. Check actual product and dimensions.

Extend Xia Corollary2.15 from big to pseudoeffective backgrounds by adding the same large a*omega to each background. All original potentials remain psh; the printed identity is a polynomial in a by nonpluripolar multilinearity. Equality for all sufficiently large a implies the constant coefficient identity. Signed product meaning must remain exact.

Use that integration by parts and vanishing of all mixed products of degree d+1 to prove energy independence under omega -> omega+ddc g (same Kahler class). Expand omega powers and retain the closed mixed factors.

Obtain a cocycle by proving that the finite-dimensional polynomial one-form h -> integral h<T_u^d> omega^(n-d) is closed on each convex potential simplex, using Xia symmetry; integrate along segments. This should give monotonicity, constant shifts c*M_d and uniform Lipschitz stability from the positive segment measures.

Concavity needs an actual nonnegative Dirichlet identity for general bounded differences of arbitrary-type singular potentials. Xia symmetry alone is not yet a locally proved gradient inequality. Find precise supporting theorem or give full new proof; otherwise leave this claim unproved.

For u fixed, binomial multilinearity gives epsilon^(-(n-d))/binom(n,d) <(T_u+epsilon*omega)^n> -> mu_{u,omega}; terms of degree >d vanish. This uses actual prescribed-type mass polynomial, not vol(alpha+epsilon[omega]) for arbitrary pseudoeffective alpha.

For u_epsilon theta+epsilon*omega-psh, |u_epsilon-u|=delta_epsilon=o(epsilon), use mixed factorization, Xia big-class signed integration by parts against smooth f, and +-ddc f<=C omega to bound rescaled operator error by O(delta_epsilon/epsilon). Prove mixed mass equals the psi reference polynomial before dividing.

For energies relative to psi in theta+epsilon*omega, ordinary cocycle stability should bound perturbation error by delta_epsilon times the actual prescribed-type raw mass polynomial. Thus only delta_epsilon->0 is proposed for leading-energy convergence. Prove the Vandermonde coefficient identity explicitly.

A path with auxiliary forms omega_epsilon -> omega in C-infinity should preserve the chosen full-form measure reference. Prove that bounded common-type mixed masses are uniformly controlled; do not infer independence under arbitrary different limiting omega forms/classes.
